english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone is smugly pleased after winning or seeing an opponent lose.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone irritatingly pleased with themselves.

examples.english: They were exultant after winning the match, and it was really irritating to watch.
examples.traditional: 佢贏咗場比賽仲喺度得戚，真係睇到人眼冤。

examples.english: You only guessed right once; no need to be so smug.
examples.traditional: 你啱啱估中一次咋，唔使咁得戚喎。
